gloss: to get an idea; to find inspiration; to conceive of an idea

definitions.gloss: to get an idea; to find inspiration; to conceive of an idea
definitions.explanation: To arrive at a creative concept or idea, often by drawing on an external source of inspiration such as a real event, another work, or a personal experience. A somewhat literary expression used in artistic and intellectual contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着想|ちゃくそう}を{得|え}た。
examples.english: I got an idea during a walk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実話|じつわ}→実話：15897_jitsuwa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{着想|ちゃくそう}を{得|え}たものだ。
examples.english: This novel was inspired by a true story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}→伝統工芸：17478_dentoukougei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{着想|ちゃくそう}を{得|え}て、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}した→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: He drew inspiration from traditional Japanese crafts and created a new design.

notes:
A literary expression meaning to find or receive creative inspiration. ⟦{着想|ちゃくそう}→着想：13704_chakusou⟧ means a concept or idea that comes to mind, and ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ means to obtain. Often used in contexts of artistic creation, scientific discovery, or creative work. More formal and literary than simply ⟦ひらめく→ひらめく：07362_hirameku⟧ or ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}いつく.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ~⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{着想|ちゃくそう}を{得|え}る: to draw inspiration from ~
- ~⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着想|ちゃくそう}を{得|え}た: inspired by ~ (modifying a noun)
- {着想|ちゃくそう}を{得|え}て: having gotten the idea, ...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヒント→ヒント：11144_hinto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ — to get a hint/clue (less formal)
- インスピレーション⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to receive inspiration (loanword, common in creative fields)
- {思|おも}いつく — to come up with (an idea) (more casual, everyday)
- ⟦ひらめく→ひらめく：07362_hirameku⟧ — to have a flash of inspiration (emphasizes sudden insight)
